info.name: FoC D3 Demo
info.description:
Postman transcription of the wiki's D3 Demo Script (curl walkthrough): proves Order + Credit and the async pipeline work without the UI, through the gateway only. Run top to bottom with the Collection Runner or newman (see docs/postman/README.md); every request carries its own assertions. Steps mirror the wiki numbering; the saga waits are polls instead of sleeps, request ids are captured from responses instead of assuming a clean stack, and balance checks are deltas against the Step 1 baseline. The cancel/drop steps use 2-credit requests so the whole run fits the 5-credit provision (3 are transferred to the courier in Step 8). A full run spends the requester down to 0 available - rerun against the same stack with a fresh seeded user pair (see README).

AI-assisted (CS3219 AI Usage Policy disclosure): Tool: Claude Code (Fable 5), 2026-10-20, Leong Wei Zhi. Scope: transcription of the wiki D3-Demo-Script page into this collection, with bodies, paths, and status codes taken from the merged contracts (order-service README, docs/credit-service.md "Read API contract", docs/notification-service.md); no design decisions by the tool. Reviewed by: Leong Wei Zhi (via pull request).
